description: A quiet antechamber where the curator left ten riddles etched into brass plates. Answer each riddle to prove your wit and earn passage — these enigmas feed the Daily Challenge for sharp-minded solvers.

levels.title: The Voiceless Voice
hints: 🤔 You find me in canyons and empty halls.
🤔 A sound that bounces back — an 'echo'.

mechanic.riddle_text: I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. I have no body, but I come alive with the wind. What am I?

levels.title: The Leaving Trail
hints: 🤔 Think about going for a walk.
🤔 Every step you take leaves something behind.

mechanic.riddle_text: The more you take, the more you leave behind. What are they?

levels.title: Keys Without Locks
hints: 🤔 You use it every day to type.
🤔 It has letter keys and a space bar.

mechanic.riddle_text: I have keys but no locks, space but no room. You can enter, but you can't go inside. What am I?
mechanic.hint: Found in front of a screen

levels.title: Cities Without Houses
hints: 🤔 I show places without being them.
🤔 You unfold me to find your way.

mechanic.riddle_text: I have cities but no houses, forests but no trees, and water but no fish. What am I?
What runs all around a yard, yet never moves?

levels.title: Lighter Than Air
hints: 🤔 You take it in and let it out.

mechanic.riddle_text: I'm light as a feather, yet even the strongest person can't hold me for long. What am I?

levels.title: A Neck, No Head
hints: 🤔 It has a long top part.

mechanic.riddle_text: What has a neck but no head?

levels.title: Wetter When It Dries
hints: 🤔 You use it after a shower.

mechanic.riddle_text: What gets wetter the more it dries?

levels.title: Branches, No Leaves
hints: 🤔 Think of a place, not a tree.

mechanic.riddle_text: I have branches, but no fruit, trunk, or leaves. What am I?

levels.title: Always Ahead
hints: 🤔 It's the opposite of the past.

mechanic.riddle_text: What is always in front of you but can never be seen?
